description: Skelet G09b-06 deterministic kit ZIP packaging

compatibility.instructions: Could the kit-package module, its test file, or the CI lens-list addition regress any existing lens contract, manifest assembler semantic, validator rule, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any wrong ZIP structure (signatures, offsets, sizes), wrong CRC32, unenforced withheld exclusion, trusted mismatched document, broken self-digest rule, non-converging finalization, unsorted entries, varying timestamps, or test/implementation mismatch?

evidence.instructions: Are the 13 unit tests sufficient for known vectors, canonical JSON, round trip, byte-identical rebuilds, sorted order, withheld exclusion, withheld-supplied/missing/extra/mismatched failures, budget cap, nothing-shippable, self-digest tampering, corruption/truncation, and malformed input?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic byte, unhandled ZIP shape, integer overflow in size accounting, or clock/time dependence?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond deterministic packaging and parsing: compression, encryption, network, storage, job lifecycle, or public API?

security.instructions: Any path traversal into the archive, withheld-byte leak, CRC forgery acceptance, zip-bomb amplification (stored method, scope-capped), or secret material in the module or tests?
